Institute of Astronomy
Fascinated by the wonders of the Universe? Eager to learn more about the life of stars, exoplanets, telescopes and spacecrafts? Discover the educational programmes and research fields of the Institute of Astronomy (IvS).

Education
The Institute of Astronomy is involved in two master programmes:
The 2-year Master Astronomy & Astrophysics and the 1-year Advanced Master of Space Studies, together with Ghent University.
Explore the programmes
Research
Our activities are related to the study of stellar evolution in a broad context. The KU Leuven Institute of Astronomy is an expert centre in the fields of asteroseismology, evolved low-mass stars, exoplanets, and astronomical instrumentation.
Discover our research

Get to know us
The Institute of Astronomy of KU Leuven is a section of the Department of Physics and Astronomy of the Faculty of Science, within the Group Science, Engineering and Technology. The institute harbours about 90 national and international staff members.
